children: Grades were mixed on Friday, dealers said, on the first full day of the volatile roll trading period.
Traders use the roll trade period to square positions, adjust slates and net out any exposure.
Prices to roll positions from December to January was seen bid and offered between a 50 cent and $2 premium to US crude futures
US energy firms this week added rigs for a second time in five weeks, energy services firm Baker Hughes
said in its closely followed report.
The total oil and gas rig count, an early indicator of future output, rose by six to 607 in the week to November 20, its highest since April 26, 2024.
Light Louisiana Sweet (WTC-LLS) for December delivery was steady at a midpoint of a $2.25 premium and was seen bid and offered between a $2.00 and $2.50 a barrel premium to U.S. crude futures
Mars Sour (WTC-MRS) rose 12 cents to a midpoint of a $3.63 discount and was seen bid and offered between a $4.25 and $3.00 a barrel discount to U.S. crude futures
WTI Midland  (WTC-WTM) rose by 25 cents to a midpoint of a 15-cent premium and was seen bid and offered between a 5-cent and 25-cent a barrel premium to U.S. crude futures
West Texas Sour (WTC-WTS) rose 15 cents to a midpoint of a $3.60 discount and was seen bid and offered between a $3.70 and $3.50 a barrel discount to U.S. crude futures
WTI at East Houston (WTC-MEH), also known as MEH, traded between a 70-cent and 90-cent a barrel premium to U.S. crude futures
rose 59 cents to settle at $92.57 a barrel​.
futures rose 97 cents to settle at $83.41 a barrel.
The Brent/WTI spread (WTCLc1-LCOc1) narrowed 65 cents to last trade at minus $8.89, after hitting a high of minus $8.86 and a low of  minus $9.65.
